title: Critique: the foundation reads like a metaphysical wish list

statements.text: Kim argues that serious metaphysics starts from a sparse base and shows it yields what is wanted, and that building consciousness, mental causation and agency into the foundations is philosophical indulgence. Giving every simple individual some proto-mentality, spontaneity and creativity reminds him of a metaphysical wish list.

sources.quote: But Griffin’s metaphysical foundation -- the foundation of his panexperientialism -- does remind one of a metaphysical wish list.
To me, it is a form of philosophical indulgence to purposely and consciously build into our foundational metaphysics exactly what we want to protect and save.
